newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Great Ocean says H1 net up 7.35 pct.
newsitem.headline: Great Ocean says H1 net up 7.35 pct.

text.p: Shenzhen Great Ocean Shipping Co Ltd said on Monday net earnings rose 7.35 percent to 23.67 million yuan in the January-June period over the same period last year.
In an interim report published in the Shenzhen Securities Times, Great Ocean said its main operating income climbed 1.95 percent to 80.47 million yuan.
It did not specify whether the results were compiled under Chinese or international accounting standards.

The Shekou-based shipper said the earnings advance partly reflected efforts to expand the scale of its operations, adding that operations would be better in the second half with the addition of two marine container ships to its transport fleet.
Each of the two ships have a capacity to carry 700 twenty foot equivalent units (TEU) and will be rented for US$10,000 per day, the firm said.
One ship was operational in June this year while the other one will be handed over for use next month, it said.
Great Ocean said in its annual report in April that under Chinese accounting standards it had net earnings of 50.39 million yuan in 1995, up 26.77 percent over the previous year.
